D: After the loss of their king, Wakanda faces a powerful hidden undersea nation.
P: Serve the snacks when Shuri first sees the underwater city of Talokan.
S: the hidden underwater kingdom of Talokan
Diced prawns cured in lime juice for 20 minutes until opaque, tossed with red onion and coriander, piled onto small corn tostadas with smashed avocado.
Green plantains sliced thin, fried at 180C until crisp, salted and served with a chilli peanut dip.
Haiti accra taro fritters with pikliz

Grated taro mixed with garlic, chilli, spring onion and thyme, fried in spoonfuls until crisp, with a fiery pickled cabbage pikliz. A day ahead, pack a quarter of a shredded cabbage, 1 grated carrot, half a sliced onion and 2 sliced chillies into a jar, cover with 300ml white vinegar and the juice of 1 lime. Grate 600g peeled taro and mix with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, 3 spring onions, thyme, 1 egg, 2 tbsp plain flour and salt. Fry spoonfuls at 175C for 4 minutes until crisp. Serve with the pikliz.
M: Namor's people and their Mayan roots
Pork shoulder marinated in achiote, orange and lime, wrapped in banana leaves and slow cooked at 150C for 4 hours, with tortillas and pickled red onion.
Queen Ramonda's jollof with grilled chicken

Smoky jollof rice cooked in a rich tomato, capsicum and chilli base with thyme, topped with charred spiced chicken thighs and fried onions. Blend 2 red capsicums, 400g canned tomatoes, 1 onion and 1 chilli. Fry 1 sliced onion in oil, add 2 tbsp tomato paste and the blend and cook 15 minutes until thick. Add 400g rinsed long grain rice, 500ml chicken stock, thyme, 1 tsp curry powder and salt, cover tightly and cook gently 30 minutes. Rub 1kg chicken thighs with paprika, garlic and oil and grill 6 minutes a side.
W: Silky baked coconut custard under a dark, glossy caramel, turned out and sliced, with toasted coconut flakes and lime zest on top. Melt 150g sugar in a pan until deep amber and pour into a 20cm round dish. Whisk 4 eggs, 400ml coconut milk, 395g condensed milk and 1 tsp vanilla, then pour over the caramel. Sit the dish in a roasting tin of hot water and bake at 160C for 50 minutes until just set. Chill overnight, run a knife round the edge and turn out. Top with toasted coconut and lime zest.
K: Talokan coconut and lime agua fresca
the deep blue sea of Talokan

Coconut water and fresh coconut blended with lime and a little sugar, strained and served icy cold with mint and lime wheels. Blend 1L coconut water, 100g shredded fresh or desiccated coconut, the juice of 3 limes and 3 tbsp caster sugar until smooth. Strain through a fine sieve, pressing hard. Chill for 1 hour. Pour into 4 glasses filled with ice and garnish with lime wheels and mint sprigs.

s.note: the hidden underwater kingdom of Talokan
s.how: Dice 400g green prawns and cover with the juice of 4 limes for 20 minutes until opaque. Drain and toss with diced red onion and coriander. Spread smashed avocado on crisp corn tostadas and pile the prawns on top just before serving.

Peel 3 green plantains and slice very thin. Fry at 180C in batches until crisp and golden, then salt well. Whisk 4 tbsp peanut butter with warm water, a pinch of chilli flakes and a squeeze of lime to a smooth dip and serve alongside.

m.note: Namor's people and their Mayan roots
m.how: Blend achiote paste with the juice of 2 oranges and 2 limes and rub over 1.5kg pork shoulder. Wrap in banana leaves and roast covered at 150C for 4 hours until it falls apart. Shred and serve in corn tortillas with lime-pickled red onion.
